claims.text: Jack's Camp is in Botswana's Makgadikgadi Salt Pans, the remnants of an enormous super-lake that once covered most of Southern Africa.

findings.quote: Jack’s Camp is located in Botswana’s Makgadikgadi Salt Pans, the remnants of an enormous super-lake that used to cover most of Southern Africa.

claims.text: Adventurer Jack Bousfield set up the first camp on the site in the 1960s.

findings.quote: In the 1960s, crocodile catcher and legendary adventurer Jack Bousfield set out on a trapping expedition in the desolate Makgadikgadi Pans.
he set up a camp in that very spot
That was the first incarnation of Jack’s Camp

claims.text: Tent interiors feature rich textiles from around the world, cabinets of curiosities, Persian rugs and hand-carved beds.

findings.quote: Their iconic interiors are embellished with rich textiles from around the world, cabinets of curiosities, Persian rugs, hand-carved beds

claims.text: Framed Peter Beard pictures hang alongside original posters from French taxidermist Deyrolle and Bousfield family photos.

findings.quote: Framed Peter Beard pictures sit alongside original posters from French taxidermist Deyrolle, both complemented by Bousfield family photos.

claims.text: Tents have an over-bed cooling system and an en-suite bathroom with indoor and outdoor showers.

findings.quote: an over-bed cooling system to ward off the desert heat and an en-suite bathroom with indoor and outdoor showers

claims.text: Afternoon tea with cucumber sandwiches and biscuits is served in a round tent strewn with Persian rugs and giant cushions.

findings.quote: afternoon tea, where cucumber sandwiches and biscuits are served in a round tent strewn with Persian rugs and giant cushions

claims.text: Spa treatments are available at additional cost.

findings.quote: Spa treatments available (at additional cost)

claims.text: A helicopter flight over the Makgadikgadi Pans can be taken with doors on or off.

findings.quote: enjoy a helicopter flight over the Makgadikgadi Pans (doors on or off)

claims.text: Guests can explore the desert landscape on horseback.

findings.quote: Explore this wild, desert landscape the same way the earliest explorers did – on horseback.

claims.text: Between March and April the pans are a flamingo breeding site.

findings.quote: A flamingo breeding site – between March & April – the Makgadikgadi Pans turns in to a pink extravaganza.

claims.text: Wildlife includes aardwolves, bat-eared foxes, honey badgers and black-maned Kalahari lion.

findings.quote: Other carnivores that know how to eke out their survival here include aardwolves and bat-eared foxes, honey badgers and black-maned Kalahari lion.

claims.text: Each guest tent has an expansive deck with a private plunge pool and views of the Makgadikgadi Salt Pans.

findings.quote: on the outside there is an expansive deck with private plunge pool and magnificent views of the shimmering Makgadikgadi Salt Pans

claims.text: The camp has pioneered a meerkat habituation project with researchers, and guests can meet the habituated meerkats.

findings.quote: We’ve been busy pioneering a meerkat habituation project with some of the world’s pre-eminent researchers.
Hang out with our habituated meerkat who live in Makgadikgadi.

claims.text: Jack's Camp is one of three camps in a one million-acre private wildlife reserve.

findings.quote: Jack’s Camp is one of just three camps in a one million-acre private wildlife reserve.

claims.text: From November to March, 30,000 zebra and wildebeest arrive on the pans in Africa's second largest migration.

findings.quote: Witness the 2nd largest migration in Africa. Nov-March 30,000 zebra & wildebeest arrive on the Pans.

claims.text: Guided quad biking crosses the salt-crusted pans.

findings.quote: take an exhilarating quad bike across the salt-crusted pans
Guided Quad Biking

claims.text: WhataHotel notes the remote desert location requires charter flight access.

findings.quote: Spa treatments available (at additional cost)
